profile.ja: 狐の獣人。人間界では妖狐と呼ばれている。魔界にある氷雪地帯に生息している獣人族の一部族。見た目は少女で耳は頭の上にあり尖がっており、お尻にはふわふわの尻尾がはえている。狩りを好み、警戒心が強いが人間界の狐と同じで人や魔族に慣れてしまえば犬猫のように懐いてしまう。ブリジットは狐族の族長の娘で無邪気で幼いながらひょいひょい色々なところに行ってはいろんな経験を積み、狩りをしては土産を持って帰ってくる。最近では魔界での狩りに飽きてしまい人間界に行って色々と学んでいる。戦闘の時は人型から巨大な獣型に変化し相手をかみ殺す。人型でも戦闘は可能だが普通の人間に毛がはえたくらいの強さである。
profile.en: Brigitte is a fox beast-person. In the Human Realm she's called a "yōko." She belongs to a tribe of beast-people that inhabits the icy snowfields of the Demon Realm. She looks like a girl, with pointed ears atop her head and a fluffy tail on her rear. She loves hunting and is very wary, but like foxes in the Human Realm, once she gets used to people or demons she becomes as affectionate as a dog or cat. Brigitte is the daughter of the fox tribe's chieftain; though innocent and childlike, she darts about, gaining all sorts of experience, and brings back trophies from her hunts. Lately she's grown bored of hunting in the Demon Realm and has been traveling to the Human Realm to learn new things. In battle she can transform from human form into a gigantic beast form to bite her foes to death. Even in human form she can fight, possessing strength roughly equivalent to a normal human covered in fur.

text.ja: 「よろしく～。妖狐ブリジットっていうんだ。覚えといてね～」
text.en: Nice to meet you~. I'm a yōko named Brigitte. Remember that~

text.ja: 人間界では妖狐って呼ばれているけど、そんなに警戒しなくてもいいよ。ただの狐だよ！！
text.en: They call me a yōko in the Human Realm, but you don't have to be so wary. I'm just a fox!!

text.ja: 毎日狩りをして、楽しいことばっかりして生きていきたいな
text.en: I want to spend every day hunting and doing fun things forever.

text.ja: 最近は魔界での狩り飽きちゃった。だから今は人間界でいろいろ学んでいるんだ
text.en: I've gotten bored of hunting in the Demon Realm lately, so now I'm learning all sorts of things in the Human Realm.

text.ja: 族長に狩りだけじゃなく、戦闘も勉強しろと言われているんだ。めんどくさい
text.en: The chieftain told me to study combat as well as hunting. What a hassle.

text.ja: この耳と尻尾ふわふわでかわいいでしょ。自慢なんだ！！
text.en: Look how cute and fluffy these ears and tail are. I'm proud of them!!

text.ja: 戦闘強くなりたいな。人型になって戦闘もできるけど、人間に毛が生えたくらいの強さなんだ。がんばる
text.en: I want to get stronger in battle. I can fight in human form, but I'm only as strong as a human covered in fur. I'll do my best.

text.ja: 狐族の族長の娘なんだ。でも家の事何もしないで狩りばっかり行ってるからたまに怒られるんだ
text.en: I'm the chieftain's daughter, but I spend all my time hunting and never help around the house, so I get scolded sometimes.
